edits.old: Then the change is refused and nothing is written
edits.new:
Then the change is refused and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC8 The business rules BR1 to BR8 hold on every call (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-document and rwb-case contract mocks answer "RC-2026-000604"
    When the pack is composed and a decision is recorded
    Then the pack is derived and no pack row or pack column is written (BR1)
    Then the decision record is written before anything is presented or announced (BR2)
    Then the case states are announced and not written (BR3)
    Then the notice and the template status are read and never written (BR4)
    Then the same request or the same Idempotency-Key twice writes one record (BR5)
    Then no v_ace_* view, no ACE table and no other rwb_* schema is read (BR6)
    Then no personal data enters the pack, the record, the log or any call (BR7)
    Then no business value is written in code (BR8)

  Scenario: AC9 A call without valid authentication, without the Litigation right or for an out-of-scope case is answered 401, 403 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a call to one of the three operations of rwb-litigation for "RC-2026-000604"
    When the call is made without valid authentication
    Then the answer is 401
    When the call is made by a role without the Litigation right
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002
    When the call is made for a case outside the caller's scope
    Then the answer is 404

  Scenario: AC10 A replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key is answered from the first result (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write for "RC-2026-000604" has been answered under an Idempotency-Key
    When the same request is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then no second decision record is written, no second pack is presented and no second announcement is sent; the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC11 A retried or timed-out activity writes no second record (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision record of "RC-2026-000604" is written and the task raise to the litigation officer fails
    When the task raise is retried with the same Idempotency-Key, or the activity times out and is retried
    Then the task raise is retried with the same Idempotency-Key and no second decision record is written

| TC-E5-004-23 | AC10 | Component | A replayed write with the same Idempotency-Key: one decision record, one presentation, one announcement; the repeat counted |
| TC-E5-004-24 | AC11 | Component | The task raise retried with the same Idempotency-Key after a failure, and a timed-out activity retried: no second decision record |
